parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Section one.

You will hear two friends called John and Anna talking about a holiday Anna has just had on Jackson Island.

First, you have some time to look at questions one to seven on page two.

You will see that there is an example that has been done for you. On this occasion only, the conversation relating to this will be played first.

Hi, Anna. How was your holiday to Jackson Island?

It was good. There's quite a lot to see. It's quite a big island, really.

Yeah. I was thinking of going in the summer. So where would you recommend going on the island?

Well, the capital, of course, Camford. I stayed there with my cousin.

Anna stayed with her cousin, so cousin has been written in the space.

Now we shall begin. You should answer the questions as you listen because you will not hear the recording a second time. Listen carefully and answer questions one to seven.

Hi, Anna. How was your holiday to Jackson Island?

It was good. There's quite a lot to see. It's quite a big island, really.

Yeah. I was thinking of going in the summer. So where would you recommend going on the island?

Well, the capital, of course, Camford. I stayed there with my cousin.

What did you do there?

Well, actually, I spent most of my time there shopping.

So has it got good shopping centers?

Yes, but they're the same as at home, really. So I did all my shopping in the market, which is great.

Hmm. What kinds of things are good to buy there?

Everything, but bags and shoes, especially. [chuckles] Just make sure you've got cash with you, as most of the stalls don't take credit cards.

Okay, that's good to know. Where else did you go?

Well, my cousin and I went to Newtown.

Mm.

She said it was famous for its modern architecture. We only had half a day there, so we took a bus tour around the town. But if I were you, I'd give the bus tour a miss.

Hmm.

Unless you know a lot about architecture, the buildings all look the same. There's a museum, though. That's supposed to be good. You might like that.

Okay, I'll give it a go.

Then after that, we headed for Golden Beach because we were going to meet up with an old friend that I hadn't seen for years. But we had to stay in a caravan as the hotels were all booked up.

[chuckles] Is it as pretty as it looks in the brochures?

Yes, it's very picturesque. We did some sailing on the most beautiful blue sea. It was so clear that you could see the bottom, even quite far out to sea. That part of the trip was great, and I'd have liked to have stayed even longer. I'd suggest staying there for a minimum of four days if I were you.

Mm-hmm.

We had two days there, and it wasn't nearly enough.

Sounds great. I'll put that on my must-do list.

Mm.

Was that the end of your trip?

No. After Golden Beach, we drove into the center of the island to White Mountain.

White as in the color?

Yes. The island's great because you can go from the beaches up to the snowy mountain in a couple of hours.

Hmm.

We took a tent because we were going to camp, but the weather was so cold. In fact, it was snowing when I was there, that we stopped in a motel instead.

Did you go skiing then?

No, but we tried snowboarding, [chuckles] and it was harder than it looked.

Hmm.

It looks so easy when you see other people doing it, but it took me ages to get the hang of it. I wish I'd had some lessons, but you had to make your bookings in advance.

Okay, I'll look into that. Thanks.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions eight to ten on page two.

Now listen and answer questions eight to ten.

So are there any other tips or advice you could give me?

I don't know. Let me think.

Oh, one place you should try to visit is this very quaint cafe, which is at the foot of the mountain. It has the best cakes ever. It's worth going there just for them. [chuckles]

Mm. I'll have to try those.

[chuckles]

So what other advice would you give?

Ooh, let me think. Uh, we didn't really have any problems.

Well, how did you get around when you were there?

We wanted to get a motorbike at first. They're very cheap to hire and great fun to ride as the roads are very good. But it turned out not to be a good idea because the weather is so changeable.

Hmm.

You'd be much better off in a car. There are plenty of places where you can hire them, and the roads are well signposted, so you won't get lost.

And presumably, I can get a map when I get there.

Well, you can, but they are expensive. It'd be better to get one here before you go.

Great. That's been really useful. Thank you.

That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.

analyses.content: 女声提醒去市场买东西的时候必须要带上现金。
你可能会听到熟悉的“credit cards”就直接填，但录音里紧跟着说明了大部分摊位不收信用卡，要注意听完后面的否定条件来排除干扰。

What kinds of things are good to buy there? Everything, but bags and shoes especially [laughs] . Just make sure you've got cash with you, as most of the stalls don't take credit cards. Okay, that's good to know.
女声觉得当地建筑千篇一律，转而推荐去参观一个很不错的博物馆。
你可能会填最先听到的“architecture”或“buildings”，但录音用“though”进行了转折，转折之后引出的才是她真正推荐的地点。
Unless you know a lot about architecture, the buildings all look the same. There's a museum, though. That's supposed to be good. You might like that. Okay, I'll give it a go.
女声说明去黄金海滩时因为酒店全订满了，所以只能住在一个房车里。
你听到“hotels”可能就会当作答案填入，但紧跟其后的“were all booked up”说明并没有住酒店，做题时千万不能听到什么名词就直接写。
Then after that, we headed for Golden Beach because we were going to meet up with an old friend that I hadn't seen for years, but we had to stay in a caravan as the hotels were all booked up.
女声在确认黄金海滩风景很美后，提到他们在海里玩了帆船。
这道题比较直接，你容易犯的错误是在等待具体活动时注意力分散，漏听了动词“did some”后面紧跟的这项具体活动。
Is it as pretty as it looks in the brochures? Yes, it's very picturesque. We did some sailing on the most beautiful blue sea.
女声明确建议，如果去那里玩，最少（a minimum of 对应题干 at least）要待上四天。
你极易把他们自己实际待的时间“two days”当成答案，但题目问的是安娜推荐停留的时间，必须要区分清楚事实陈述和主观建议。
I'd suggest staying there for a minimum of four days if I were you. Mm-hmm. We had two days there, and it wasn't nearly enough.
女声回答去完黄金海滩后开车去了白山，并和男声确认了就是表示颜色的那个White。
遇到专有名词你可能会在拼写上犹豫，但录音中男声特意对“White”进行了拼写确认，顺着确认的思路就不会写错，同时一定要记得首字母大写。
Was that the end of your trip? No. After Golden Beach, we drove into the center of the island to White Mountain. White as in the color? Yes.
男声问他们有没有去滑雪，女声否认了，说他们尝试了单板滑雪。
你听到男声提问的“skiing”极容易顺手填上，但女声紧跟着的一句“No”直接排除了这个选项，一定要听完答语再下笔。
Did you go skiing then? No, but we tried snowboarding, [laughs] and it was harder than it looked.

analyses.content: 女声强烈推荐山脚下的一家咖啡馆，说那里有最好吃的蛋糕。
你定位到“cafe”之后如果反应变慢，就会漏听紧挨着的具体食物，或者只写了“cake”漏掉了表示复数的“s”，导致无谓失分。

Oh, one place you should try to visit is this very quaint cafe, which is at the foot of the mountain. It has the best cakes ever. It's worth going there just for them [laughs] . Mm, I'll have to try those.
在讨论交通工具时，女声建议租一辆汽车出行会好得多。
你很容易掉进“motorbike”的陷阱，但录音后面通过转折词“but”说明了由于天气多变骑摩托并不是个好主意，明确排除了这个干扰项。

Well, how did you get around when you were there? We wanted to get a motorbike at first. They're very cheap to hire and great fun to ride as the roads are very good, but it turned out not to be a good idea because the weather is so changeable. Mm. You'd be much better off in a car. There are plenty of places where you can hire them, and the roads are well signposted, so you won't get lost.
男声问能不能到了当地再买地图，女声建议最好在出发前就买好。
你听到男声提问的“map”不要急着确认，必须耐着性子听完女声建议在“出发前（before you go 对应题干 before the holiday）”购买，才算完美匹配题干的限定条件。
And presumably, I can get a map when I get there? Well, you can, but they are expensive. It'd be better to get one here before you go.
